desc: Craft beer & bar food served in a multi-story microbrewery with wood-panelled ambiance & city views.
addr: HRBR Layout 1st Block, HRBR Layout, Kalyan Nagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560043, India

rev.t: The drinks were excellent, and the ambiance was very pleasant and enjoyable. The vegetarian dishes were well-prepared and tasted great. However, some of the non-vegetarian items had a raw smell and appeared to be undercooked. We shared this …

One of a few options in kalyan nagar for a brewery. Vienna Lager is the best beer I liked. They have a jamun beer also but didn't have any colour or flavour of jamun. Food was also nice. Got a complementary dessert also with Swiggy dinout booking. Service was a slo good.
Not a bad place. The food has good quantity, and you actually start to feel full after just a few bites. The mocktails are great but sadly they didn't have a pina colada when I visited :( …
